thread:
ryan.sales: Quick heads-up 12Corp legal asks for SOC2 excerpt + a signed pen-test attestation for a short POC. They also want ephemeral KMS creds so their auditors can run an external scan. Any showstoppers?
maria.se: We can support ephemeral creds + presigned upload. Need to confirm egress rules and whether they expect Dedicated KMS isolation.
oliver.sec: From security: pen-test attestation template is available but we need buyer signer name and contact. For ephemeral KMS on Private, require KMS owner approval + a 1-page runbook. SOC2 will be redacted.
ryan.sales: They want everything by Thursday. Can we get draft attestation + SOC2 redacted bundle by then?
kevin.pm: I'll assemble a compact evidence zip. Oliver, what should we redact?
oliver.sec: Standard: remove internal IPs, internal hostnames, and service account emails. I'll drop the redaction checklist into the folder. docs-bot: SOC2 redacted snapshot uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/soc2/12corp-poc-2026-04-15.zip
maria.se: For ephemeral KMS we need their staging CIDR(s) and preferred key rotation window. Note Dedicated KMS isolation increases monthly cost.
ryan.sales: CIDRs already shared in the packet. I'll ask about rotation and signer. Add Dedicated delta to the quote.
maria.se: Ballpark: Dedicated + KMS isolation = +$3,600/mo (estimate). Final after infra signoff.
oliver.sec: If they request an independent red-team proof instead of our attestation, add ~2 weeks to the timeline.
kevin.pm: Evidence checklist I'm preparing: 1) SOC2 redacted excerpt 2) minimal network diagram 3) pen-test attestation draft 4) KMS keyflow sketch 5) presigned upload snippet 6) ephemeral creds runbook
ryan.sales: presigned snippet for their engs?
maria.se: Example: ```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/12corp-poc.zip --expires-in 3600
```
oliver.sec: Security guidance: expiry <=1h, single-use logging, include request_id in audit record.
ryan.sales: Also asked if attestation can state we support on-prem HSMs. Safe to include?
oliver.sec: Allowed wording: "Redwood supports Private deployments with customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations." Do not list specific HSM vendors.
kevin.pm: I'll upload the bundle and ping Legal for quick sign-off on the attestation wording. docs-bot: Pen-test-attestation-template_v3.docx uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/templates/pen-test-attestation_v3.docx
ryan.sales: Thanks all 1 will send to 12Corp and request signer details. If anything blocks, will update here. :thumbsup:
